target_questions.question: Does the simulation provide supporting evidence for near-field shock/core scales used to initialize far-field jet models?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 B004 separates near-field shock structure from far-field similarity; this paper tests their modelling connection.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The validated simulations reproduce Mach-disk and potential-core scales and identify a downstream location beyond the shock cells but before the end of the potential core for far-field initialization.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Near-field gas-dynamic predictions are compared with measurements and correlations, then used to propose far-field initial conditions.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: near-field shock structure to far-field similarity

limitations: Safety-release configurations and model validation ranges; not an engine-transient experiment.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
